questions.ask: What bulb trade number do I need for the back-up light?
questions.answer: GE1156 (32 CP) - lamp bulb chart, printed p.10

questions.ask: C'est quoi l'ampoule pour les feux stop / clignotant / arrière / plaque?
questions.answer: 3157 (32/3 CP) - printed p.10

questions.ask: No power to the stop arm (front and rear stop arm), which fuse feeds the stop arm power connector?
questions.answer: Fuse F38 (10304) via circuit B119 16GY to stop arm power connector 10359 cavity A; switched by stop arm relay 10310 - printed p.417

questions.ask: On the MTA electrical panel, where is the stop arm relay located?
questions.answer: Relay block 10310-B5, position R1 = STOP ARM RELAY - printed p.28

questions.ask: Le relais des feux de recul sur le panneau MTA, il est où?
questions.answer: Bloc relais 10308-B11, position R2 = BACK UP LIGHTS RELAY - printed p.28

questions.ask: Les feux de recul marchent pas sur un bus Eaton avec ISB 2017, c'est quel fusible pis quel relais?
questions.answer: Fuse F20 (1011) feeding the backup light relay #R4 (1011); also back up light check relay (1016) - printed p.478

questions.ask: What breaker rating is used for the parking brake buzzer with Bendix on the MTA panel?
questions.answer: Breaker 23, 30A (parking brake buzzer W/Bendix); 10A is N/Bendix - printed p.32

questions.ask: Sur le bloc fusibles du harnais platform (pas MTA), le F7 c'est pour quoi?
questions.answer: F7 = BAT KEY SWITCH - printed p.34

questions.ask: Which fuse on the platform harness fuse block is the ignition feed for the back-up lights?
questions.answer: F20 IGN BACK-UP LIGHTS - printed p.34

questions.ask: Master disconnect circuit (MTA): what wire runs from ACC 1 relay pin 87 to fuse B12-F, color and gauge?
questions.answer: B12HL 10BK - printed p.61

questions.ask: Sur le master disconnect (bloc pas MTA), le relais 3 du master disconnect alimente quels fusibles?
questions.answer: Master disconnect relay 3 (10320) feeds fuse F20 via B12E 12BK and fuse F23 via B12F 10BK (10302) - printed p.152

questions.ask: On the 2017 ISB with WTEC trans, which pins on the 500K diagnostic connector are J1939 high and low?
questions.answer: Pin C = J1939+ (A5M(+) 18YL), pin D = J1939- (A5M(-) 18GN), connector 1651 - printed p.187

questions.ask: Key switch has no battery feed on the 2017 ISB diesel, what fuse and wire feed it?
questions.answer: Fuse F7 (1011) via wire A15 16RD to key switch (1100) cavity A - printed p.213

questions.ask: Le câble de l'alternateur (borne B) vers le démarreur, c'est quoi le numéro pis la grosseur?
questions.answer: K2B 1RD, then fusible link K2BA-FL 6TN to starter power (6313) - printed p.213

questions.ask: Seat belt alarm switch: which wire goes to the body controller and on which pin?
questions.answer: A79 18GY to J3-RED body controller (1600) pin A3 (seat belt alarm I/P); other side A9BB 18GY to zero volt reference - printed p.230

questions.ask: Sur le schéma du bras d'arrêt (feuille 1A), le fil B119P part vers le 'stop arm extend' CH9_03. Sur cette feuille-là, il arrive sur quelle cavité?
questions.answer: B119P 16GY arrives at stop arm extend connector 10358A cavity A (CH9_03), splices to B119D to stop arm relay 10310 - printed p.417 and p.419

questions.ask: On the stop arm extend sheet, what wire goes to the crossing gate relay with the MTA fuse block?
questions.answer: !B119L 16GY from 10358A cavity E to crossing gate relay 10313-R1 (CH9_06) - printed p.419

questions.ask: Le fan clutch embraye pas sur un ISB 2017 / B6.7, c'est quel fusible pis quel relais?
questions.answer: Fan fuse (4115) 10A and fan drive relay (4116); IGN fan fuse (4111) 20A with IGN fan relay (4014) - printed p.444

questions.ask: Turn signals not working on a bus with the remote hazard switch: which body controller inputs and wires should I check?
questions.answer: J3-RED body controller (1600): A7 left turn signal input (A56B 18OR), A6 right turn signal input (A57B 18OR) - printed p.502

questions.ask: La résistance de terminaison du Bendix Fusion 3, c'est combien d'ohms?
questions.answer: 120 ohms, terminating resistor (19390) - printed p.575

questions.ask: Child Checkmate / Theft Mate with snooze and lift: which fuse powers the Theft Mate red dot?
questions.answer: Fuse F3 (30304) via B13A 18PK - printed p.800

questions.ask: Next gen hydraulic park brake wheelchair relay: what circuit is on cavity 5?
questions.answer: KA122A, 18 GY - printed p.890
questions.option_note: # = N/0508108 not MTA fuse block W/F-2017-ISB-engine & F-2018 propane/gasoline

questions.ask: Le relais de la valve de drain auto, il est où pis c'est quoi le fil sur la cavité 3 avec un ISB 2017?
questions.answer: Left side of vehicle at flasher plate (%1018); cav 3 = A39D 16 GY (terminal 1661709C1) - printed p.907

questions.ask: Emergency exit relay, cavity 2, on a propane/gasoline engine bus: circuit, gauge, color?
questions.answer: A117E, 16 GA, GY - printed p.907

questions.ask: Connecteur feu stop #1, cavité C, avec ABS-8 ESP/Wingman/Fusion: quel fil?
questions.answer: A70CA 16 GY - printed p.991
questions.option_note: # = W/Bendix ABS-8 W/ESP/Wingman/Fusion (* ABS-6 & ABS-8 = 18 OR)

questions.ask: Redundant power fuse holder in the engine compartment: what's on cavity A?
questions.answer: M14HA, 8 GA, RD (4041A) - printed p.1016
questions.option_note: * = common for vehicle W/0508108 MTA and N/0508108 not MTA W/F-2017-ISB, F-2021-B6.7

questions.ask: Haldex drain valve on a propane/gas bus: circuit on cavity A?
questions.answer: M39B 14 BK (*9527) - printed p.1104
questions.option_note: * = common W/0508108 MTA and N/0508108 not MTA W/F-2018-PROP/GAS-ENG

questions.ask: L'alarme frein de stationnement pas mis (park brake not set alarm), quel fil sur la cavité 1?
questions.answer: A79B 16 RD (*9999) - printed p.1122
questions.option_note: * = common for vehicle W/ MTA and N/ MTA fuse block

questions.ask: LH rear cap ground splice: what's on cavity A and what gauge?
questions.answer: D11-GA, 10 GA, WH (%10160) - printed p.1155
questions.option_note: % = common W/0508108 MTA and N/0508108 not MTA

questions.ask: C'est quoi le fusible pour le chauffage du chauffeur dans le bloc fusible au flasher plate (10301)?
questions.answer: F1, 20A, cavities A1,B1 - printed p.1184

questions.ask: Hazard flashers are dead (non-MTA fuse block at the flasher plate). Which fuse and rating?
questions.answer: F27 HAZARD LIGHTS 3A, fuse block 10303 - printed p.1191

questions.ask: Le capteur de recul (reverse motion sensor) marche pas, c'est quel fusible?
questions.answer: F33 REVERSE MOTION SENSOR 5A, fuse block 10303 - printed p.1191

questions.ask: La lumière stroboscopique fonctionne pas, quel fusible je check au bloc fusible du flasher plate?
questions.answer: F62 STROBE LIGHT 7.5A, fuse block 10306 - printed p.1198

questions.ask: Relay block 10310 at the flasher plate: which cavities hold the stop arm relay, and with a front stop arm what circuit is in A1?
questions.answer: Stop arm relay at A1,A2,B1,B2 (sheet 15C); A1# = B119B 18 GY (sheet 15A, chart continued on 15B/15C) - printed p.1213 and p.1215
questions.option_note: # = W/FRONT STOP ARM; @@ = N/0508108 not MTA

questions.ask: Sur le panneau MTA, la feuille des fusibles A1 dit de voir une autre feuille pour les ratings. C'est quelle feuille, pis le breaker stop arm/crossing gate c'est combien?
questions.answer: Refer sheet AE08090653_032; breaker 16 = 7.5A STOP ARM/CROSSING GATE - printed p.28 and p.32

questions.ask: Where is the heated air seat connector and what's on cavity B?
questions.answer: Located at electrical panel (&10368); cav B = B105 16 LTGN - printed p.1255
questions.option_note: & = common W/0508108 MTA and N/0508108 not MTA

questions.ask: La lumière de direction latérale avant de la roue arrière (side dir lt 10779), pin A c'est quoi?
questions.answer: F57J 18 LTGN, located at body - printed p.1374
questions.option_note: @ = common W/MTA and N/MTA W/5,7,9,11 RH WDO

questions.ask: Sur la charge AC haute tension (PB10E00), la mise à la terre du chargeur OBC c'est quel fil?
questions.answer: 12YL/GN from OBC J1 cavity G to frame ground - printed p.1477

questions.ask: EV booster pump switch at the driver control panel: what's on cavity 2?
questions.answer: B62GF 18 GY (10255A) - printed p.1519
